messages:
🎉 Barcelona · Sat 28 Nov
Sunday is general-election day in Spain; Barça are away at Deportivo (Sun 16:15), so that one is a bar screening, not a stadium trip.

TODAY · Sat 28 Nov

1. Carolina Durante — Fin de la aventura (tour finale)
🕘 Sat 21:00 (doors 19:00) · 📍 Palau Sant Jordi
📊 Arena show at Palau Sant Jordi; tickets still listed on sale (La Ganzúa, Time Out)
💶 From €38
💬 Spain's biggest indie-rock band closing their tour in the arena: the largest crowd in town tonight, expect thousands and a loud sing-along. Mostly local crowd; tickets were still on sale today.
https://www.laganzua.net/conciertos/carolina-durante-barcelona-1014063

2. Catupecu Machu
🕘 Sat 21:00 · 📍 Razzmatazz 2
📊 Razzmatazz 2 concert, on sale via Ticketmaster/Fever (Songkick, La Ganzúa)
💶 From €38.99
💬 Argentine rock veterans, so the room will be largely Argentine: expect several hundred in a mid-size hall. Cielo Razzo (Rosario) also play La (2) de Apolo at 19:30 if you want a cheaper Argentine gig.
https://songkick.com/concerts/43337658-catupecu-machu-at-razzmatazz-2

3. SOUNDIT Plaza: Joy Orbison, Aurora Halal, TRS, EYRA
🕘 Today 16:00 → 22:00 · 📍 Plaza Monumental de Barcelona
📊 2,043 interested on RA · RA Pick · also on DICE
💶 18€, 22€, 25€, 28€, 32€
💬 Open-air daytime rave in the old bullring with Joy Orbison headlining; the biggest electronic event of the day, expect a couple of thousand. Also flagged in @planesenbarcelona's weekend round-up. Over by 22:00.
https://ra.co/events/2480242

4. Adam Beyer presents Drumcode - Hivernacle Barcelona
🕘 Tonight 22:00 → 04:00 · 📍 Plaza Mayor de El Poble Espanyol
📊 1,687 interested on RA
💬 Adam Beyer's Drumcode takes over Poble Espanyol's main square for Hivernacle's season closing: big-room techno, expect well over a thousand. The late option after a concert or SOUNDIT.
https://ra.co/events/2554309

5. TARDEIG ELECTRÒNIC X Chica Club Presents: Classics
🕘 Tonight 18:00 → 00:00 · 📍 Chica Club
📊 219 interested on RA · also on Eventbrite
💶 Free
💬 Free tardeo: house and disco classics from 18:00 to midnight in a club. A couple of hundred likely, listed on both RA and Eventbrite. Easy early start with friends before the bigger nights.
https://ra.co/events/2567218

TOMORROW · Sun 29 Nov

1. Cazzu — Latinaje tour
🕘 Sun 20:00 · 📍 Razzmatazz 1
📊 Razzmatazz main room; a second Barcelona date (Mon 30) was added on demand
💶 From €39.70
💬 Argentina's biggest female trap star, so a largely Argentine and Latin crowd filling Razzmatazz's main room, well over a thousand. Check tickets first: if Sunday is gone, the added Monday date is the way in.
https://www.laganzua.net/conciertos/cazzu-barcelona-1015209

2. CHURROS CON CHOCOLATE - 80's
🕘 Sun 16:00 → 05:00 · 📍 SALA APOLO
📊 no public headcount (DICE doesn't publish one)
💶 €19.51
💬 Barcelona's best-known Sunday tardeo: pop hits, 80s theme and drag shows from 16:00. Apolo opens both rooms for it, so expect over a thousand. Very LGBTQ-friendly, mixed and fun; ticket includes a drink.
https://dice.fm/event/8e97g7-churros-con-chocolate-80s-29th-nov-sala-apolo-barcelona-tickets

3. Grecas — Escrito en la M-30 (tour finale)
🕘 Sun 21:00 · 📍 Sant Jordi Club
📊 Sant Jordi Club show, on sale via Ticketmaster
💶 From €39.70
💬 Madrid rapper closing his album tour in the city's second-biggest indoor venue: a young Spanish crowd in the low thousands. In Spanish; the biggest gig of the day by venue size.
https://www.laganzua.net/conciertos/grecas-barcelona-1016328

4. SOCIAL LAB X BUS HEXPERIENCE
🕘 Sun 12:00 → 22:00 · 📍 BUS Hexperience
📊 202 interested on RA
💬 All-day vinyl session at the BUS food-and-music space in Poblenou: house DJs, food and a sociable daytime crowd, a couple of hundred across the day. Drop in any time from noon with friends.
https://ra.co/events/2585477

5. Salsa & Latin Vibes
🕘 Sun 18:00 → 22:00 · 📍 La Paloma
📊 #1 of 18 on Xceed by popularity · venue has 64 followers on Xceed
💶 €13.50–95
💬 Salsa with a live band in La Paloma's old ballroom, the most popular Sunday listing on Xceed. A big dance floor that suits a few hundred; mixed ages, good if anyone in the group dances.
https://xceed.me/en/barcelona/event/salsa-latin-vibes-75/251363

Scanned: RA 63 · DICE 27 · Xceed 18 · Eventbrite 164 · Luma 4 · Instagram 27 posts + 16 stories (partial). Not available today: Meetup (every request failed).
